scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:partner && npm run install:admin && npm run install:shared
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:partner" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:partner && npm run build:admin
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend
scripts.migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
